name: Dummy
concept: A plain reference fighter for benchmarking: no card text, no Super, two identical cards of each type. In its own mirror it plays the three triangle types about evenly (Pressure 29%, Convert 33%, Recover 30%, typeless 8%).
notes: Added 22 Oct 2026. HP calibrated the same day: at 25 HP the signed-off fighters average 49.3% against it (Gambler 51.4%, Bastion 44.8%, Vex 46.9%, Atlas 54.0%; Hard, 4,000 games each, seeds 5, 9, 13 and 17, seats alternated). 24 HP gave 53.2%.
